title: LP2-27–32: eleven-rune sums of 563 and 569
question: Do sums 563 and 569 recur in eleven consecutive runes elsewhere in the Wing and Tree section?
summary: A complete within-page census finds seven windows summing to 563 and ten to 569 among 1373 starts. This measures recurrence, not chance probability.

scope.representation: All alphabet runes in archived LP2-27–32 order, including headings; separators removed; each page remains a separate stream; Gematria Primus prime values.
scope.procedure: Enumerate every eleven-consecutive-rune window within each page and count sums equal to fixed targets 563 and 569; retain every window and its coordinates.
scope.parameters: Length 11; targets 563 and 569; one-rune steps; all 1373 eligible starts in six pages; no page crossing, wrapping, reversal or padding.
scope.exclusions: Grid columns and perimeters, manuscript-row selection, other lengths or targets, cross-page windows, file-dimension retesting, null-model simulations, image provenance and decryption.

finding: 563 occurs seven times across LP2-28, LP2-29, LP2-31 and LP2-32; 569 occurs ten times across LP2-27–31. Mean window sum: 784505/1373, approximately 571.38.
limitations: Targets and section were selected after the original observation. Overlapping windows share ten runes; hit counts are not independent trials or p-values. No unspecified image-only row claim is evaluated. Human review pending.
next_steps: Freeze any further lengths, boundary rules or null model as separate variants before assessing significance.
